name: 27614 · Raleigh, NC
findings: ZIP 27614 (Raleigh) has 133 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (11% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27614 (Raleigh) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 16 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
